raw.details:
Welcome to the Walchand Collegiate Programming Contest (WCPC)!

Get ready to dive into an exciting and challenging world of competitive programming. WCPC brings together the brightest minds from various colleges for a contest where coding, logic, and teamwork take center stage.

This contest, inspired by the renowned ICPC (International Collegiate Programming Contest), will push your problem-solving skills to the limit. With two rounds of intense competition, this is your opportunity to showcase your coding abilities and collaborate with your team to rise above the rest.

Why Participate?

  • Prove Your Skills: Compete in two thrilling rounds—the Preliminary Round, where teams race to solve a variety of problems, and the Final Round, where the best teams battle it out for the top spot.
  • Teamwork: Join forces with 1 to 3 members from your college to take on the challenge. In the preliminary round, each team can use up to three PCs, while the final round will require you to work together on one PC.

The Contest Format:

  • Two Rounds:
    • The Preliminary Round this will be an online round, it consists of 8 problems of varied difficulty. Teams must solve as many as possible within the given time.
    • The Final Round this will be an offline round, it will once again challenge teams with 8 problems, pushing their coding and teamwork abilities to the max.

Eligiblity

  • College students from 1st year to final year.
  • Cross-college teams not allowed.
  • Read the rulebook for more details.

Payment Details

The registration fee for WCPC is based on the number of members in each team:

  • Team of 1 Member: ₹140
  • Team of 2 Members: ₹190
  • Team of 3 Members: ₹240

Note: The registration fee will be applicable according to the final team size selected during registration.

WCPC is your chance to shine, to put your skills to the test, and to experience the thrill of competitive programming at its finest.

Let the contest begin!
